name: One Summer in Loliwood
source:
Bernd arrives in Los Angeles to visit his injured uncle, who asks him to take up a job in a prestigious chauffeur company. While driving various celebrities around he chances upon the knowledge that a well known child porn company is situated in the city, and decides to investigate with a goal of shutting it down.

Of course, things will not go as Bernd expects...
